Large, bold white Traditional Chinese text overlays are centered on the screen, introducing the 'mousse can' tasting. (2) A sequence of close-up shots shows various cats—including ginger, black-and-white, and calico breeds—actively eating from white ceramic plates. Each plate is accompanied by a small white product label indicating different seafood flavors like scallop, sea bream, and perch. The cats' facial expressions show focus and enjoyment as they lick the food. (3) The camera captures a ginger cat licking its mouth clean after finishing its meal, emphasizing the palatability of the product. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the cat's fur and the creamy consistency of the mousse-style cat food on the plates. (4) A close-up shot shows a hand using a grey spatula to scoop out the rich, brown mousse-textured food from a silver can.
